definitions.explanation: A magazine published once a week. Japan has a large weekly magazine industry covering news, entertainment, gossip, and manga.

examples.japanese: {週刊誌|しゅうかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I bought a weekly magazine at the station and read it on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられて→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧、⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: The incident was widely covered by weekly magazines and became a hot topic.

notes:
{週刊誌|しゅうかんし} is a magazine published weekly.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{月刊誌|げっかんし}→月刊誌：11513_gekkanshi⟧: monthly magazine
- ⟦{季刊誌|きかんし}→季刊誌：11514_kikanshi⟧: quarterly magazine
- {日刊紙|にっかんし}: daily newspaper

CULTURAL NOTE:
Weekly magazines are a major part of Japanese media. They range from news-oriented publications to entertainment and manga anthologies. They are commonly sold at train station kiosks and convenience stores.
